requirement: Land cells that touch only diagonally must now count as connected: an island is a maximal group of land cells connected through any of the 8 surrounding cells (up, down, left, right and the four diagonals). The return value is unchanged: (number of islands, number of cells in the largest island).
desc: grid is a rectangle of rows of equal length made of "#" (land) and "." (water). An island is a maximal group of land cells connected through any of the 8 neighbouring cells (up, down, left, right and the four diagonals). Return (number of islands, number of cells in the largest island); a grid with no land, including an empty grid, gives (0, 0).
